pydevtools.py.summary: Python and Rust project scaffolding and packaging toolkit.
details: Subcommands: ``init`` scaffolds a project (setuptools, hatchling or the typer/click CLI variants) with the README, ``.gitignore``, tests and metadata, ``make-setup`` generates a ``setup.py`` from a directory, a wheel or a config, ``cargo-toml`` turns a ``Cargo.lock`` into a ``Cargo.toml``, ``dev`` bootstraps the development environment and the pre-commit hooks, ``new-script`` emits a script template.

pydiff.py.summary: Diff two files line by line.
details: Reads both files in parallel, compares the hashes first, prints the differing lines with their line numbers and, with ``-s -m``, moves the files that match after the whitespace strip into a numbered ``group_N`` folder.

pyenhance.py.summary: Fix the escaped regexes, invalid escape sequences, bytes literals and ``is`` comparisons.
details: Rewrites the regex patterns and the string literals that should be raw, doubles the invalid escapes, fixes the non-ASCII bytes and the ``is`` comparisons with literals (``--no-is`` skips that); ``--check`` makes it a CI gate, ``--diff``/``--backup``/``--dry-run`` control the output.

pyextract.py.summary: Extract the functions, classes and constants of Python sources and archives.
details: Parses with ast, LibCST or tree-sitter (``--parser``), writes the entities with the per-entity, per-type, per-folder, JSON or SQLite layout (``--layout``), skips the tests with ``--skip-tests`` and also reads the ``.py`` members of zip, wheel, tar and zstd archives.

pyfmt.py.summary: HTML, CSS, JS and JSON formatter with several backends.
details: The ``format`` subcommand beautifies with tree-sitter (HTML), js-beautifier, prettier or prettify (``--tool``), the ``list-large`` one reports the big HTML files; it can move the failures with ``--move-errors-to`` and runs the batches with the chosen executor.

pyget.py.summary: A pip-style download manager with progress bars.
details: Downloads the URLs (or the list of ``-f``) with the stdlib, requests or pycurl backend, picks the chunk size from the size, resumes from the ``.part`` files, derives the name from the URL or the ``Content-Disposition`` and shows the ``pip``-style progress display.

pymonolith.py.summary: Save a web page as one HTML file with the CSS, JS, images and fonts embedded.
details: Fetches the URL (or reads the local file), inlines the stylesheets and scripts, rewrites the ``url(...)`` references as data URIs, keeps the fonts and images inside the page and writes the archive to ``-o`` (with ``-t`` timeout and ``-e`` for the ignored errors).

pypi_update_check.py.summary: Check the installed PyPI packages for newer releases.
details: Compares the installed versions with the latest ones on PyPI through the JSON API (requests or pycurl backend, several aliases for the same check), keeps a state file to resume, throttles the requests and writes the result to the output file or JSON with an optional log.

pypi_user_pkgs.py.summary: List the packages published by a PyPI user or organisation and optionally download them.
details: Scrapes the user's profile pages, saves the package names to ``<user>.txt`` and with ``-d`` downloads the latest release of each package (httpx, urllib, requests, pycurl or aria2c backend) below the size limit.

pypidl.py.summary: PyPI package downloader with several strategies and mirrors.
details: Subcommands: ``basic`` downloads the preferred ``py3-none-any`` wheel, ``download`` streams a specific version, ``wheels`` fetches the wheels in parallel scored by the Python version, ``mirror`` tries the PyPI, Tsinghua and Runflare mirrors with the hashes verified and ``scrape`` parses the ``/simple`` index.

pyqalc.py.summary: Quick command-line calculator with unit conversion.
details: Evaluates the arithmetic, the scientific functions and the unit conversions with :class:`decimal.Decimal` at 28 digits, honours the ``-p`` precision and the ``-d`` degrees mode for the trigonometry and offers an interactive shell with ``-i``.

pyrg.py.summary: A ripgrep-like recursive regex search in Python.
details: Searches by regex or fixed string with the ignore-case, invert, multiline, only-matching and replace options, filters by the ``-e`` extensions or the ``-t`` type presets, honours an ignore file and skips the excluded globs, colouring the matches and streaming the files through a worker pool.

pyrun.py.summary: Run every Python file of a directory with a per-file timeout, in parallel.
details: Discovers the ``.py`` files, executes each one with a subprocess bounded by ``--timeout`` (30 s default), classifies the outcomes (ok, error, timeout) and prints the per-file result and the summary.

pyterser.py.summary: Minify JavaScript files in place with terser.
details: Runs terser with the compress/mangle/toplevel/module options on the ``.js``/``.mjs``/``.cjs`` files, keeps the result only when it is smaller and valid, supports ``--dry-run``, ``-q`` and a timeout, and processes the tree in a pool.

python_downloader.py.summary: A pip-style download manager for the current directory.
details: Probes each URL for the size and the name, resumes from the ``.part`` files, splits the big files over four range requests, shows the ``pip`` progress bar and supports the stdlib, requests or pycurl backends with ``-F`` to re-download the existing files.

pytokei.py.summary: Count the code, comment and blank lines by language.
details: Detects the language from the extension or the shebang, counts the code/comment/blank lines per file, skips the binaries and the excluded paths and prints the per-language totals (``--no-report`` silences the summary).
